---
title: Add a landing page after submission
---

`landing_page.xml` is optional at submission time — [I. Validate the bundle](validate.qmd)
only warns if it's missing, it doesn't fail the gate. If you submitted without
one and want to add it retroactively, you don't need to resubmit the dataset.

::: {.callout-note}
## Current process, subject to change

The steps below are the current process, confirmed with WP2. WP2 is also
integrating a new Metadata submitter (from CSC), with the plan to have the new
submission process in place during Q3 — that is expected to change how
submissions, and follow-up fixes like this one, are handled. If this page
looks stale, check with [Support](support.qmd) before following it.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Scope

This page covers adding a missing landing page. It does not cover other
post-submission fixes (for example, replacing a corrupted/bit-lost file) —
that process hasn't been documented yet. For those, contact
[Support](support.qmd) directly.
:::

## Do it

1. **Prepare the landing page.** Build a valid `landing_page.xml` (and any
   `LANDING_PAGE/THUMBNAILS/` files it references) for the already-submitted
   dataset, following the same structure described in
   [Prepare data](direct-upload/prepare-data.qmd). Validate it before sending
   anything — see [Validate metadata](direct-upload/validate-metadata.qmd).

2. **Upload it to the original dataset's folder.** Do **not** create a new
   submission. WP2 asked that this go directly into the same dataset folder
   you originally submitted to, rather than as a fresh bundle — contact
   [Support](support.qmd) first if you're unsure of the exact inbox path for
   an already-submitted dataset.

3. **Notify NBIS by email.** Send an email to the
   [helpdesk](mailto:{{< var email.helpdesk >}}) so they know a landing page
   was added to an existing dataset. WP2 asked for this step specifically —
   there's no separate submission for the file to ride along with, so the
   email is what gets it picked up. Include:
   - the dataset's identifier (`DATASET_<alias>`),
   - that this is a **landing-page addition to an already-submitted dataset**,
     not a new submission,
   - the uploader's name.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Verify

There's no local check for this — the file lives on NBIS's side once
uploaded. Once WP2 confirms it's been processed, the dataset's entry in the
[BigPicture browser](https://datasets.bp.nbis.se/index.html) should show the
landing page.
:::

## If something goes wrong

- **Not sure the file went to the right place** — email
  [support](support.qmd) with the dataset identifier before assuming it
  failed silently; WP2 can check what arrived.
- **Landing page still isn't showing after some time** — same as above:
  contact [support](support.qmd) rather than re-uploading repeatedly.
